motor.gemini.kisa: Google's translation AI. A good way to start.
motor.claude.kisa: Paid; you pay as you use it.
motor.yerel.rozet: No internet, free, a bit weaker
motor.yerel.kisa: Runs on your computer, nothing leaves it.
motor.deepl.kisa: DeepL translation service. Needs a key.
motor.yerel.yerel_not: This option needs no internet and no key.

anahtar.nereden: Where do I get the key?
anahtar.guvenli: The key is stored only in this computer's encrypted vault. It is never sent anywhere except the translation service you chose.
rehber.gemini:
Open aistudio.google.com.
Sign in with your Google account.
Press "Get API key".
Create the key and copy it.
Paste it here. The free allowance has limits that can change; check the page.
rehber.deepseek:
Open platform.deepseek.com and sign in.
Go to "API keys" in the left menu.
Press "Create new API key" and copy it.
You need to add a small balance. Prices can change; check the page.
Paste it here.
rehber.claude:
Open console.anthropic.com and sign in.
Go to "API Keys" in Settings.
Press "Create Key" and copy it.
You need to add credit to your account. Prices can change; check the page.
Paste it here.
rehber.deepl:
Create a DeepL "API Free" account.
Go to "API Keys" on your account page.
Copy the key.
Paste it here. The free quota has a limit.

Still nothing? Close and reopen the program, then try again.

oyun.paket: A friend gave me a translation pack
oyun.ad_gerekli: Please type the game name first.
oyun.hitap: Characters talk to each other with

oyun.atla: Continue without a game for now
oyun.yok.k: If you pick a game, I can remember its translations.
oyun.paket.aciklama: Choose the .akpaket file your friend sent. Its translations are added to your memory.
ana.ne.durdu: When you press Start, I read the text on screen and show the translation where you chose.
ana.ne.calisiyor: I am reading and translating the text on screen. Press Stop when you are done.
izin.baslik: Should I remember this game's translations?
izin.govde: If I remember, the same sentences are translated instantly and in the same way next time. Everything stays only on this computer and is never sent to anyone. You can delete it any time.
son.ne: If a sentence looks wrong, press Fix. From then on it is always translated your way.
son.bos: Sentences show up here once translating starts.
duzelt.tamam: Done. From now on I will always translate it this way.

oneri.atildi: OK, I will not add this.
kalite.ne: Higher quality can be a little slower and cost more.
kalite.en_iyi.k: May be a little slower and more expensive.
kalite.dengeli.k: A middle path between speed and quality.
kalite.hizli.k: Gives results right away; quality may be a little lower.
hafiza.ne: I keep what I translated on this computer. Nothing is sent to anyone.
hafiza.ac.k: Nothing is saved while this is off.
hafiza.sil_govde: Every translation I remember for this game is deleted. This cannot be undone.
paylas.aciklama: This file only has sentences; no keys or personal information. You can send it to a friend.
ayar.ne: Choose here whether menus and mission text are translated too.
sozluk.ne: Write a name here if you want it to always stay the same.

guncelleme.yeniden: The program will restart by itself.
guncelleme.ne: When a new version is out you install it with one click; your settings and game memory are kept.
ayar.guncelleme.k: Asks GitHub at most once a day if a new version exists; none of your information is sent.
guncelleme.guncel: Your program is up to date (version {surum}).
tv.kart.baslik: Install on the TV in one click
tv.kart.ne: This sends the TV app from the computer to your TV; you do not need to install anything else.
tv.kart.adimlar:
On the TV open the Developer Mode app; Dev Mode Status and Key Server must be on.
Type the TV's IP address and the code shown on screen (Passphrase) below.
Press Install and wait.
tv.kart.eksik: Type the TV's IP address and the code shown on screen.
tv.kart.ayrinti_not: If you send us this text it is much easier for us to fix the problem.
bolge.otomatik_durum: Right now automatic: I find the text on screen by myself.
bolge.secili_durum: {n} box(es) chosen. Only these boxes are read.
bolge.otomatik: Let it find text itself (no boxes)
bolge.ipucu: Drag to draw a box. Drag a corner to resize, the middle to move. Press a box's label to choose what it is. Keyboard: on the picture Enter adds a box, arrows move, Shift+arrows resize, Enter picks the type, Delete removes.
bolge.dolu: You've drawn {n} boxes, that's the maximum. Remove one to draw another.
bolge.kutu_aria: Box {n}: {tur}. Arrows move, Shift+arrows resize, Enter picks the type, Delete removes.
erisim.tamam: Code accepted. Dubbing is now unlimited on this computer.
dublaj.ne: Characters speak Turkish in their own voices. Only the game's sound is listened to, the microphone is never turned on, and no audio is recorded.
dublaj.gecikme: The Turkish voice starts being prepared the moment a subtitle appears; it usually arrives with the line or 1–2 seconds later. Subtitles always come first.
dublaj.donanim_yok: No powerful graphics card was found on your computer.
dublaj.kapali.k: Only subtitles are shown; the voice is not translated.
dublaj.chatterbox.k: Best quality, needs a powerful graphics card
dublaj.pocket.k: Works on any computer, quality is a little lower
dublaj.elevenlabs.k: Most natural, paid; the voice sample goes to ElevenLabs
dublaj.eleven.anahtar_kayitli: Key saved ✓ (type again to change it)
dublaj.eleven.onay: I understand and accept that the translated sentences are sent to ElevenLabs (a service on the internet).
dublaj.eleven.klon: Also upload the character's voice sample to ElevenLabs and create a temporary voice clone there. I accept this separately; it is deleted when the session ends.
dublaj.eleven.ses.k: If you do not confirm voice cloning, enter the ID of a ready-made voice in your account. Then no voice sample is sent.
dublaj.hazirla.k: The needed voice model is downloaded once; it can be several GB.
dublaj.kis: How much to lower the game sound
dublaj.cikis: Where to play the Turkish voice
dublaj.cikis.bilgisayar.k: The game sound is lowered and the Turkish voice plays from the computer.
dublaj.cikis.tv.k: The voice plays from the TV app; the game sound is not lowered.
dublaj.haklar: For personal use. Recording and publishing the dubbed audio or video (YouTube etc.) is subject to the rights of the game and its voice actors.
tercih.hareket.k: Turns off sliding and glow effects.
durum.hata.yakalama: Stopped: could not capture the screen
durum.hata.yakalama.k: Make sure the game window is open and not minimised, then press Start. If that fails, use "Run setup again" to pick the screen again.
durum.hata.genel.k: Press Start once more. If it stops again, close and reopen the program.
hata.uc_yok: This feature isn't in this version of the program. Update the program and try again.
hata.zaman: The program didn't answer this time. Wait a moment and try again; if it keeps happening, close and reopen the program.
kare.yok: Couldn't get the game picture. Make sure the game is open and not minimised, then try again.
asama1.baslik: Where do you play the game?
asama1.alt: Pick one, then pick the window or screen where the game shows.
asama1.ne: We're finding the picture I'll read text from. Once you see the right picture, this step is done.
goruntu.tamam: I can see the game picture.
goruntu.resim_alt: Game picture taken from the selected window
sorun.asama1:
If the picture is black, switch the game to "Windowed" or "Borderless window" mode, then press "Refresh picture".
If the game isn't in the list, open it and press "Refresh list"; otherwise pick "Whole screen".
Don't minimise the game window; it can stay in the background.
For PS5/Xbox, connect to the game in Remote Play or the Xbox app first.
asama2.baslik: Can I read the text on screen?
asama2.alt: Open a part of the game with text (dialogue, quest, menu), then press the button.
asama2.ne: I read the text in the picture once and show it to you. I mark what I find with boxes on the picture.
okuma.sifir: I didn't find any text in this picture.
okuma.sifir.k: Open a game screen that has text on it, then try again. For example dialogue, a quest line or a menu.
okuma.resim_alt: Game picture with the read text marked
sorun.asama2:
Pick a moment in the game that really has text: dialogue, a quest line or a menu.
If the text is tiny, make subtitles/UI bigger in the game's settings.
On Windows, make sure the English language pack is installed under "Settings › Time & language › Language" (text reading needs it).
Make sure you picked the right window in the picture step.
asama3.alt: Pick one and run a quick test. You can change it later.
asama3.ne: I translate "Hello, how are you?" with the engine you pick. Once you see the translation, this step is done.
yerel.gerekli: For offline translation I need to download a language file of about {mb} MB, once. After that it works without internet.
yerel.iniyor.k: This happens once. You can leave the page; the download continues.
yerel.hazir: The language file is ready. I can now translate without internet.
yerel.indirme_hata: The language file couldn't be downloaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
yerel.gizlilik: The file is only downloaded when you press "Download". Translations happen on this computer and are never sent anywhere.
sorun.asama3:
Make sure no spaces were copied before/after the key, and paste it again.
If you just created the key, wait a few minutes and try again.
No internet? Pick "Offline (local)" and download the language file.
Open "Details" in the error box and send us a screenshot.
asama4.baslik: Where should I show the translation?
asama4.alt: Pick where the translated text appears. Then I'll send a test line.
asama4.ne: I send a 4-second test line to the place you picked. If you saw it, press "Yes" and this step is done.
gosterim.bilgisayar: On this computer's screen (over the game)
gosterim.bilgisayar.k: Text appears transparently over the game; your clicks still go to the game.
gosterim.tv: On an LG TV (over the game)
gosterim.tv.k: Install the app on your LG webOS TV; text shows over the game on the TV.
gosterim.tarayici.k: Phone, tablet, another computer or an OBS browser source.
gosterim.yakinda: For Samsung, Android/Google TV and Apple TV see the "Connection guides" below; mirroring the screen is very easy.
gosterim.tamam.bilgisayar: You saw the text on this computer's screen.
gosterim.tamam.tv: You saw the text on the TV.
gosterim.tamam.tarayici: You saw the text in the browser.
katman.aciklama: I open a transparent layer in front of the game that doesn't block your clicks.
katman.destek_yok: Text can't be shown over the game on this computer. Use "In another device's browser / OBS" instead.
katman.hangi_ekran: Which screen is the game on?
katman.gordun_mu: Did you see the text on your screen?
tarayici.gordun_mu: Did you see the text in the browser?
deneme.gonderildi: Sent. Look at the screen now: the text shows for 4 seconds.
sorun.katman:
Switch the game to "Windowed fullscreen" or "Borderless" mode (in the game's Display/Video settings). In exclusive fullscreen the text can end up behind the game.
If you have several screens, pick the one with the game above.
Minimise the game and press "Test on screen" on the desktop; if it shows there, the game's fullscreen mode is the problem.
Otherwise use "In another device's browser / OBS".
sorun.asama4:
On this computer: switch the game to "Borderless window" mode.
On the TV: TV and computer on the same Wi-Fi, and the TV app open.
In a browser: type the address by hand; if the firewall asks, choose "Allow".
asama5.alt: Draw boxes with the mouse around what you want translated. Up to 6 boxes. Or skip this step and I'll find the text myself.
sorun.asama5:
If the picture is old, open a moment with text in the game and press "Refresh picture".
Draw boxes a bit wider: leave room for the text to grow.
Not sure what to draw? Press "Suggest from read text", then adjust the boxes.
If you draw no boxes, I find all on-screen text myself ("Find it automatically").
bolge.ilk_ipucu: Draw boxes with the mouse around what you want translated: e.g. the dialogue at the bottom, the quest text at the top left.
bolge.bos: No boxes yet. Drag on the picture to draw one, or press "Suggest from read text".
bolge.oner_yok: I found no text to suggest boxes from. Open a moment with text in the game, press "Refresh picture" and try again.
bolge.onerildi: I suggested {n} boxes. Adjust them as you like, then save.
bolge.tamam: I saved {n} areas. I'll read only these boxes.
bolge.tamam_otomatik: Automatic: I'll find the on-screen text myself.
bolge.katman_aria: Game picture. Press Enter to add a box.
bolge.tur_ne.ust_yazi: Quest, hint, info; in its own place
asama6.alt: All five steps work. Open the game and press Start.
asama6.alt_eksik: You skipped {n} steps. Do them now if you like; you can also start anyway.
asama6.baslat_not: To stop, just press Stop on the main screen.
asama6.ana: Go to the main screen without starting
yerel.gerekli_bos: For offline translation I need to download a language file once. After that it works without internet.
okuma.paket.baslik: The English text-reading pack is recommended
okuma.paket.aciklama: Windows' {dil} reader is being used now; it reads English too but may mix up letters. You can install Windows' own English reading pack with one click (free, Windows will ask for permission).
okuma.paket.basladi: Installation started. If Windows asks for permission, press 'Yes'. Restart the program in 1–3 minutes.
tercih.kapat.onay: Quit the program? Translation will stop.
tercih.kapat.bitti.k: You can close this tab. Double-click the desktop icon to open it again.
son.liste_aria: Recent translations list. Use the up and down arrow keys to scroll.
bolge.rehber1: Draw a box around the text to read. Then choose where the translation goes: on the same spot, on the bottom bar, or draw a place yourself.
bolge.rehber2: Do not box in numbers in the game (score, money); I will not translate them.
bolge.nereye: Where should I write the translation?
bolge.hedef_aria: Translation place (target) for box {n}. Arrows move it, Shift with arrows resizes, Delete removes the target, Enter returns to the source box.
bolge.mod_ciz: Draw the translation place for box {n}: drag on the picture. I put a ready place there, you can move it if you like.
bolge.ipucu_hedef: If you chose the translation place yourself, you can move and resize that dashed box the same way. Changing the text size shows a sample text in the selected box.
gorunum.ekran_olcek.k: If the text looks too big or too small, adjust it here.
rehber.alt: Pick the easiest way for where you play and where you want to see the translation. Every guide is a few short steps.
rehber.adres_baslik: Address to type in the TV browser
rehber.adres_yok: The address appears here while the program is running.
rehber.adres_not: This way the text shows on a separate screen, not over the game.
rehber.cihaz.yok: I could not find the {ad} window.
rehber.cihaz.yok.k: Follow the steps below, then press "Refresh list".
rehber.liste_k: Very easy steps for a TV or monitor
kaynak.ekran_uyari: You picked the whole screen. If you pick the {ad} window, I read only the game and never mix in the panel's own text.
bilgi.aciklama: I learn the game's character, place and item names, so they are not mangled in translations.
bilgi.not: I do a short research (10–30 seconds). Nothing is saved until you approve it.
bilgi.calisiyor: Researching the names for "{ad}"… This can take 10–30 seconds.
bilgi.inceleme.k: Untick anything wrong, fix the translations you like, then Save.
bilgi.hitap: How should characters address each other?
bilgi.bos_terim: I found no terms for this game. You can still save just the description.
bilgi.kaydedildi: Saved. {n} terms learned; these names will be kept in translations.
bilgi.cevrimdisi: This needs an online engine. I suggest choosing Gemini as the translation engine (a free key is enough), then try again.
rg.pc.ne: When a game is in "exclusive full screen", Windows does not hand me the picture. In "borderless" mode I can read the text and the game stays smooth.
rg.pc.s1: Put the game in windowed mode
rg.pc.s1.k: In the game's Graphics/Display settings, set the screen mode to "Borderless" or "Windowed fullscreen".
rg.pc.s2.k: Launch the game and wait for the picture. Do not minimize it.
rg.pc.s3: Pick the game window from the list
rg.pc.s3.k: Find the game's name in the list above and pick it. If you pick the window instead of the whole screen, I read only the game.
rg.pc.sorun:
If the picture is black, switch the game to "Windowed", then press "Refresh picture".
If the game is not in the list, open it and press "Refresh list".
If nothing helps, pick "Whole screen"; it still works.
rg.ps5.ne: Your PS5's picture opens in a window on the computer. I read that window; nothing needs installing on the console.
rg.ps5.s1.k: From playstation.com download and install "PS Remote Play" (for Windows, free).
rg.ps5.s2: Sign in with your PlayStation account
rg.ps5.s2.k: Use the same account as on your PS5. You can create one on the same page.
rg.ps5.s3.k: Keep the PS5 on or in rest mode, with PS5 Settings > System > Remote Play turned on. Pick your PS5 in the app.
rg.ps5.s4: Keep the Remote Play window open
rg.ps5.s4.k: Do not minimize it; it may sit behind other windows but must stay visible.
rg.ps5.s5: Pick the "PS Remote Play" window from the list
rg.ps5.s5.k: In the list above, pick the "PS Remote Play" row. It carries a "Recommended" badge.
rg.ps5.sorun:
If the window is missing, start a game in Remote Play, then press "Refresh list".
If the picture is black or frozen, make sure the window is not minimized.
If it will not connect, the PS5 and the computer must be on the same internet connection.
rg.xbox.ne: Your Xbox game opens in the Xbox app on the computer. I read that window.
rg.xbox.s1.k: Open the "Xbox" app on Windows (or get it free from the Microsoft Store).
rg.xbox.s2: Sign in with your Microsoft account
rg.xbox.s2.k: Use the same account as on your Xbox.
rg.xbox.s3: Start the game with "Remote play" or "Cloud"
rg.xbox.s3.k: Turn on remote play in your console's settings. Connect to your own console or pick a Cloud game.
rg.xbox.s4: Pick the Xbox window from the list
rg.xbox.s4.k: In the list above pick the window that says "Xbox", and do not minimize it.
rg.xbox.sorun:
If the window is missing, start the game and press "Refresh list".
If there is no picture, check that the game really started in the Xbox app.
Keeping the app open and not minimized is the most reliable.
rg.kart.ne: The card brings the console's picture to the computer. If a program shows it in a single window, I read that window.
rg.kart.s1.k: Open OBS Studio (obsproject.com, free). If you use Elgato / 4K Capture Utility, open that; the picture is already in its window, so skip to step 4.
rg.kart.s2.k: In the Sources panel press +, choose "Video Capture Device" and pick your card.
rg.kart.s3.k: Right-click the source you added and pick "Windowed Projector (Source)". The picture opens in its own window.
rg.kart.s4: Pick that window from the list
rg.kart.s4.k: In the list above pick the one called "Windowed Projector" or "Projektör".
rg.kart.s5.k: Do not minimize it; the game picture must stay visible in it.
rg.kart.sorun:
If the window is missing, open the projector and press "Refresh list".
If OBS shows black, check the card's driver and cables.
If the picture lags, turn on a "low latency" option in the source properties if there is one.
rg.bilgisayar.ne: The translation appears as see-through text over the game. No extra setup; this is the easiest way.
rg.bilgisayar.s1: Put the game in borderless mode
rg.bilgisayar.s1.k: In the game's settings, set the screen mode to "Borderless" or "Windowed fullscreen" so text can show over it.
rg.bilgisayar.s2: Choose to show the translation on this screen
rg.bilgisayar.s2.k: In the wizard step "Where should I show the translation?" pick "On this computer's screen".
rg.bilgisayar.s3: If you have more than one screen, pick the right one
rg.bilgisayar.s3.k: Choose the screen the game is on; "Try" sends a small test text.
rg.bilgisayar.sorun:
If you see no text, switch the game to "Borderless"; text cannot show over "exclusive full screen".
If it shows on another screen, pick the right screen and try again.
If the text is too big or small, adjust the on-screen text size.
rg.lg.ne: You install our small app on the LG TV once; the text then shows see-through over the game on the TV.
rg.lg.s1: Put the TV and the computer on the same Wi-Fi
rg.lg.s1.k: Connect both to the same internet connection (router).
rg.lg.s2.k: Install and open "Developer Mode" from the LG Content Store. Keep "Dev Mode Status" and "Key Server" on; note the code on screen.
rg.lg.s3: Type the IP address and the code below
rg.lg.s3.k: The TV's IP address and the on-screen code (Passphrase) go into the boxes below.
rg.lg.s4.k: The app is installed and opens on the TV. You need this only once.
rg.lg.sorun:
If the code looks wrong, type the code from the TV's Developer Mode screen again exactly.
If the TV is not found, check its IP address under TV Settings > Network.
If the install fails, switch the TV off and on and re-open Developer Mode.
rg.samsung.sorun:
If the TV is not listed, check that Source > Screen Mirroring is on and that it is on the same Wi-Fi.
If the picture lags, connect the computer with an HDMI cable (see the "Monitor / HDMI cable" guide).
If it will not connect, try the TV browser address method (the address above).
rg.samsung.ne: You mirror your Windows computer's screen to the TV; the game and the text show on the TV. There can be a small delay (about half a second), so for very fast games an HDMI cable is better.
rg.samsung.s1: TV on and on the same Wi-Fi
rg.samsung.s1.k: The computer and the Samsung TV must be on the same internet connection. Screen mirroring should be on in the TV.
rg.samsung.s2: Press Win + K on the computer
rg.samsung.s2.k: Press the Windows key and K together; a "Cast" list opens on the right.
rg.samsung.s3: Pick your TV from the list
rg.samsung.s3.k: Find the TV's name and click it. If the TV asks, choose "Allow".
rg.samsung.s4.k: Press Win + P and choose "Duplicate", so the game shows on both the computer and the TV.
rg.samsung.s5: Start the game and show the translation "On this computer's screen"
rg.samsung.s5.k: Text appears over the game; the TV shows the same picture.
rg.android.sorun:
If the TV is not listed, make sure its built-in Chromecast (Cast) is on.
Alternative: in Chrome, menu > Save, share and cast > Cast > Cast screen.
If the picture lags, try an HDMI cable (see the "Monitor / HDMI cable" guide).
rg.android.ne: You mirror your Windows computer's screen to the TV; the game and the text show on the TV. There can be a small delay (about half a second), so for very fast games an HDMI cable is better.
rg.android.s1: TV on and on the same Wi-Fi
rg.android.s1.k: The computer and the Android / Google TV must be on the same internet connection. Screen mirroring should be on in the TV.
rg.android.s2: Press Win + K on the computer
rg.android.s2.k: Press the Windows key and K together; a "Cast" list opens on the right.
rg.android.s3: Pick your TV from the list
rg.android.s3.k: Find the TV's name and click it. If the TV asks, choose "Allow".
rg.android.s4.k: Press Win + P and choose "Duplicate", so the game shows on both the computer and the TV.
rg.android.s5: Start the game and show the translation "On this computer's screen"
rg.android.s5.k: Text appears over the game; the TV shows the same picture.
rg.apple.ne: To be honest: Windows has no built-in AirPlay, and Apple TV has no web browser. So the easiest way is the one below.
rg.apple.s1: Easiest: connect the computer to the TV with an HDMI cable
rg.apple.s1.k: Skip Apple TV: plug the computer straight into the TV's HDMI input (see the "Monitor / HDMI cable" guide). No delay.
rg.apple.s2: Or show the translation on the computer screen
rg.apple.s2.k: Play on the computer and show the text over the game on this screen. No extra setup.
rg.apple.s3: If you want to try AirPlay
rg.apple.s3.k: You need a third-party AirPlay sender for Windows (for example AirParrot). Pick a program you trust; there is delay, so I do not recommend it for fast games.
rg.apple.s4: A separate screen on a phone or tablet
rg.apple.s4.k: Type the address above into your phone's browser; the translation shows on a separate screen there (not over the game).
rg.apple.sorun:
Apple TV has no browser, so the address method only works on a phone, tablet or another computer.
If an AirPlay program mirrors the screen but lags a lot, switch to an HDMI cable.
If there is no HDMI input, show the translation on the computer screen.
rg.hdmi.baslik: Monitor / HDMI cable to a TV
rg.hdmi.ne: Connect the computer to the TV with a cable and the TV becomes your second (or same) screen. The text shows over the game on the TV. No delay, no setup; the most reliable way.
rg.hdmi.s1.k: Connect the computer's HDMI output to one of the TV's HDMI inputs.
rg.hdmi.s2: Select that input on the TV
rg.hdmi.s2.k: Press Source / Input on the remote and pick the HDMI input you used.
rg.hdmi.s3: Set the screen with Win + P
rg.hdmi.s3.k: On Windows press Win + P. Choose "Duplicate" to see the game on the TV too, or "Extend" for a separate screen.
rg.hdmi.s4: Show the translation on that screen
rg.hdmi.s4.k: In the wizard pick "On this computer's screen"; if you have several screens, mark the TV's screen.
rg.hdmi.sorun:
If the TV shows nothing, re-select the input and unplug and replug the cable.
If the picture is blurry, set the resolution to the TV's recommended one in Windows Settings > Display.
If the text does not show on the TV, put the game in "Borderless" mode and pick the right screen.
pano.bolge.oto.k: I find the text on screen myself.
pano.kare_alt: A small frame from the game picture
kisayol.alt: They work even while the game is open. Click a box, then press the keys you want together.
kisayol.gizle_goster.k: Hides the translations on screen; translating continues.
kisayol.yeniden_oku.k: Clears waiting text and reads the screen right away.
kisayol.destek_yok: In-game hotkeys work only on Windows. Here, use the panel to start and stop.
kisayol.bas.k: E.g. Ctrl + Shift + a letter. Esc: cancel, Delete: turn off.
kisayol.cakisma: This key is also set for "{ad}". Change one of them.
kisayol.kayit_aria: Press to change, then press the new keys together.
kisayol.ek_gerekli: Press it together with Ctrl, Alt or Shift; a single key clashes with the game.
kurulum.yeniden.k: Opens the setup wizard from the first step. Your settings are kept.
enaz.baslik: Keep very short text on screen at least this long
enaz.k: A translation stays on screen as long as the game's text. Text that vanishes at once stays at least this long.
dublaj.paket.ne: The parts that make characters speak Turkish are too large to ship inside the program. They are downloaded once and then work offline. Everything stays on this computer.
dublaj.paket.boyut: To download: about {gb} GB · Disk space: about {disk} GB
dublaj.paket.onay: I agree to download about {gb} GB.
dublaj.paket.durdu: Installation stopped. You can resume it any time.
dublaj.paket.hazir_gel: Developer mode: using the packages of this Python ✓
dublaj.paket.destek_yok: The dubbing package does not work on this computer.
dublaj.paket.kaldir.k: The package folder is deleted ({konum}). Subtitle translation is not affected; you can reinstall any time.
dublaj.diyalog.baslik: Change one game setting: Dialogue volume to 10–20%
dublaj.diyalog.k: In the game's Audio settings, do not turn “Dialogue” off; set it to 10–20%. The English voice then becomes almost inaudible on the TV under the Turkish voice, but the program can still hear the character and speak Turkish in the same voice.
dublaj.orijinal.otomatik.k: Removed completely when the sound comes from Remote Play or a capture card, otherwise lowered.
dublaj.orijinal.kis.k: The game sound is lowered while Turkish plays, then restored. The safest option.
dublaj.orijinal.tamamen_turkce.k: English speech is removed, music and effects stay. Game sound may lag slightly (about 0.3 s).
dublaj.orijinal.destek_yok: Fully Turkish does not work with this setup; the game sound will be lowered.
dublaj.giris.yok: Don't use (listen to the computer's sound)
dublaj.giris.k: Only pick this if you use a capture card (★ = looks like a card). Do not pick a microphone: the program never opens a microphone by itself.
dublaj.profil.k: The best voice samples of each character are kept on this computer and never sent anywhere. Once enough is collected, characters keep their own voices even with in-game dialogue fully off. You can delete them any time.
dublaj.hafif.k: Smaller models: turn on if graphics memory is low or the game runs on this computer. Quality drops a little.
dublaj.tani.cpu_torch_cpu: Running on the processor — this will be very slow. A {kart} graphics card is present but the dubbing package was installed without GPU support; "Repair" fixes it (~2.6 GB download).
dublaj.tani.cpu_surucu: Running on the processor — this will be very slow. The {kart} graphics card could not be used: update the NVIDIA driver and restart the computer.
dublaj.tani.cpu: Running on the processor — this will be very slow. Chatterbox needs an NVIDIA graphics card; choose the Pocket engine.
dublaj.tani.onariliyor: Installing graphics card support… (may take a few minutes)
dublaj.tani.onarim_hata: The repair did not finish; check the internet connection and try again.
dublaj.tani.neden.tv_sirasi: audio piled up on the TV
dublaj.video.ne: Pick a gameplay video you recorded (e.g. an mp4 from Xbox Game Bar or NVIDIA). English voices are removed, music and effects stay, and every character speaks Turkish in their own voice. The new video is saved next to the original; the original is never changed.
dublaj.video.paket_once: Install the dubbing package above first.
dublaj.video.yasal: Publishing the dubbed video (YouTube etc.) is subject to the rights of the game and its voice actors.
kaynak.tur.ps5: Hidden connection (no window, sends no controller input)
ps5g.baslik: Connect to PS5 in the background (recommended)
ps5g.ne: The computer connects to the PS5 in the background with a second PSN account: no window, no controller or keyboard input. You keep playing on the TV with your own account and controller.
ps5g.yalniz_windows: The hidden connection currently works on Windows only. On this computer pick the official PS Remote Play window from the list below.
ps5g.yardimci_yok: The hidden connection component is missing from this installation. Reinstall the latest version or pick the official PS Remote Play window below.
ps5g.a1: Sign in with your second PSN account
ps5g.a1.adimlar:
Add a free second user (a new PSN account) to your PS5. Do NOT use the main account you play with on the TV.
Press "Open Sony sign-in" and sign in with the SECOND account on Sony's page. Your password only goes to Sony; this program never sees it.
When sign-in finishes the page may look blank or like an error; that is normal. Copy the WHOLE address from the browser's address bar.
Paste it below and press "Save".
ps5g.a1.yapistir: After signing in, the address from the address bar (starts with remoteplay.dl.playstation.net/...):
ps5g.a1.bekle: Getting the account ID from Sony…
ps5g.a1.elle: I already know my account ID (base64)
ps5g.a1.tamam: Second account saved ({ozet}). Your password was not stored; only the account ID, in the encrypted vault.
ps5g.a2: Link the PS5 to this computer (8-digit code)
ps5g.a2.adimlar:
On the PS5 switch to the SECOND user (PS button → profile → Switch user).
Settings → System → Remote Play → turn on "Enable Remote Play".
In the same place choose "Link Device": an 8-digit code appears. Leave this screen open.
Below pick your PS5 (or type its IP address), enter the code and press "Link".
When it is done you can switch back to your main account on the PS5.
ps5g.a2.araniyor: Searching the network for the PS5…
ps5g.a2.yok: No PS5 found. Is it on and on the same network? You can also type its IP address (PS5: Settings → Network → Connection status).
ps5g.a2.pin: The 8-digit code on the PS5 screen
ps5g.a2.bekle: Linking with the PS5 (can take up to 30 seconds)…
ps5g.a3.resim: Small live picture from the PS5
ps5g.a3.soru: Does the controller at the TV still control the game? Press a button to check.
ps5g.a3.hayir: No, the controller does not work
ps5g.a3.hazir: Ready: the picture source "PS5 (hidden connection)" is selected. You can press Continue.
ps5g.a3.kol_yardim:
Press the PS button on your controller and pick your own (main) account on the TV; the controller rejoins the game.
If the second user stayed signed in on the PS5, switch to your main account on the TV.
If it still does not work press "Disconnect" and let us know; until then use the fallback below.
ps5g.a3.giris_pin: The second user's PS5 sign-in passcode (4 digits) is required:
ps5g.baglanti.uyandiriliyor: Waking the PS5 from rest mode…
ps5g.yedek.baslik: Fallback: the official PS Remote Play window
ps5g.yedek:
If the hidden connection does not work, open the official PS Remote Play app with the SECOND account and connect.
Pick the "PS Remote Play" window from the list below.
Note: on some setups control can move to the computer with this method; then press the PS button and pick your main account.
ps5g.unut.onay: Delete the linked PS5 and the second account from this computer?
guncelleme.soru: Download it now? Your settings and dubbing pack are kept.
erisim.ekle_not: Watch a short ad and get 30 minutes of dubbing. Time only goes down while dubbing runs; it is cleared when the app closes.
erisim.en_cok: Up to 4 hours can be stored. You can add more after using some.
erisim.durdu: Dubbing time is up, so dubbing paused. Subtitles keep going. Press "+30 min" to continue.
erisim.tvde: The ad is playing on the TV. 30 minutes will be added when it ends.
erisim.cihaz_not: To get an unlimited dubbing code, send this number. The code only works on this computer.
reklam.destek_alt: 30 minutes of dubbing time will be added shortly.
reklam.izin_govde: The ad is shown by an ad company. Under its own policy, that company may receive information about your device and usage (e.g. IP address, device type, whether the ad was watched). If you do not accept, we show our own 15-second thank-you screen instead; that screen sends nothing anywhere. You can change this any time in Advanced settings.
reklam.izin_ayar: Allow ads from the ad company
reklam.izin_ayar.k: When off, "+30 min" only shows our 15-second thank-you screen and sends nothing anywhere.
reklam.vast: Ad address (VAST, for the app owner)
reklam.vast.k: Leave empty to use the app's built-in setting. Only https:// addresses.
reklam.vast_hata: The address must start with https://.
baglanti.deniyor: I keep retrying; this notice disappears on its own once it's back.
baglanti.yavas_k: I'm waiting; you don't need to do anything.
canli.bos: After you press Start, the latest translated line shows up here.

tv.uyg.eski.k: Type the TV's IP address and the Developer Mode code below, then install. After this the TV app always updates itself.
tv.gel.otomatik.k: While the program is open it resets the timer once a day, so the TV app is not removed.
tv.gel.az_once: It was renewed a moment ago. You can try again in a few minutes.

ck.ne: The translation always shows up right away. Balanced: lines that stay on screen longer are re-translated better in the background and fixed in place.
ck.hizli.k: First translation only; no extra requests.
ck.dengeli.k: Lines that stay longer are improved in the background.
